blocks.text: To be afraid, to fear — бояться. a) The person or thing feared is in the Genitive case: *Я боюсь этого человека.* b) The verb «бояться» denotes the state or condition of the agent.
The verb ждать takes no preposition. The object is in the accusative case if animate and in the genitive case if inanimate: *Я жду жену. Я жду письма.*
From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lessons 27, 66.

The exercises are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. The word in brackets is the dictionary form of the missing word.
